classes.name: The Predator
classes.subtitle: Cold Manipulator
classes.description: A detached mind devoid of human empathy, regarding living beings as simple playthings to dissect, manipulate, and discard.

classFeatures.name: Surgical Detachment
classFeatures.desc: Cold disregard for pain grants +2 Armor Class and immunity to panic.

classFeatures.name: Dissection Strike
classFeatures.desc: Strike precision anatomical vulnerabilities with clinical ruthlessness.

classes.name: The Survivor
classes.subtitle: Tenacious Drifter
classes.description: An iron-willed individual refusing to submit to the sinking sensations and toxic emanations of the shifting space.

classFeatures.name: Tenacious Stride
classFeatures.desc: Stubborn resistance to spectral entanglements grants +10 maximum Stamina.

classFeatures.name: Desperate Clout
classFeatures.desc: Swing an improvised iron implement to dislodge clinging entities.

classes.name: The Analyst
classes.subtitle: Clinical Observer
classes.description: A meticulous clinician who catalogues anomalies, measures corridors, and calculates the logic behind the shifting architecture.

classFeatures.name: Lucid Observation
classFeatures.desc: Meticulous awareness reveals hidden compartments and grants +2 to all Investigation checks.

classFeatures.name: Hypothesis Testing
classFeatures.desc: Identify entity attack frequencies to anticipate and blunt spectral strikes.
